text_simplified: Parents must teach their children salah and acts of worship from a young age, with patience and good tarbiyah (upbringing). They should also instill love for goodness and truthfulness in their hearts, and warn them against bad akhlaq (character). Islamic tarbiyah relies on good role models and continuous guidance.
